newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher, followed KCBT.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher, followed KCBT.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed higher largely in reaction to strong gains in KCBT May hard red winter wheat futures, traders said.
A sharp decline in deliverable stocks in Kansas City fueled KCBT's gains, traders said.

In Minneapolis, buying also was motivated by talk of spring wheat planting delays and forecasts for above normal precipitation through next week. Flooding in the Red River Valley bordering North Dakota and Minnesota was expected to delay spring week planting until mid-May, cash grain dealers said late Monday.
MGE spring wheat futures closed up seven to 2-1/2 cents, with May up most at $4.18-1/2 per bushel and July four cents higher at $4.07-3/4.
Estimated trading volume was 31.574 million bushels, with 14.217 million in May and 11.275 million in July.
